notablePrerequisites: Saproling Burst has at least two fade counters on it.
description:
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a */* Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Tainted Observer triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Repeat.
